claims.claimed_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Analysis of the cyanide impurity content of the purified tembotrione that precipitated out at different PH values. claims.evidence_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Title of invention: Purification method for a tembotrione product

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

claims.evidence_en: Tembotrione is prepared by reacting 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid with thionyl chloride to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride, which is then reacted with cyclohexanedione to give the enol ester, and which by way of an acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement reaction finally gives tembotrione. The reaction scheme is as follows (Formula 2): Tembotrione is prepared by reacting 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid with thionyl chloride to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride, which is then reacted with cyclohexanedione to give the enol ester, and which by way of an acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement reaction finally gives tembotrione. The reaction scheme is as follows (Formula 2): Into a three-necked flask were added 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane, held at 15 degrees C and stirred. Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid. evidence_lines.text_en: Into a three-necked flask were added 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane, held at 15 degrees C and stirred. Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid.

Into a three-necked flask were added 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane, held at 15 degrees C and stirred. Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid.

Before the said 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoyl chloride reacts with cyclohexanedione, a suitable base such as triethylamine may be added to form an enol ester solution; after the rearrangement reaction is finished, further distillation gives the tembotrione product.

Before the said 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoyl chloride reacts with cyclohexanedione, a suitable base such as triethylamine may be added to form an enol ester solution; after the rearrangement reaction is finished, further distillation gives the tembotrione product.

claims.evidence_en: Into a 2 L three-necked flask were added 231.9 g of the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1 L of 1,2-dichloroethane, and the mixture was stirred at 15 C. 237.9 g of thionyl chloride was slowly added. Reaction at room temperature for 0.5 h, then the temperature was raised to 75 C and held for 3 h. In-process control found the starting material content to be no more than 0.2%. Under -0.098 mP the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure up to 85 C, removing the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane, 500 ml, and triethylamine, 200 g, were added again, and 92 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 0.5 g of acetone cyanohydrin were charged, then held at 40 C for 6 h. The reaction was checked and found to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give the tembotrione product as a red-brown solid. To the tembotrione product was added 40% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, then 5 g of activated carbon was added and held for 1 h, hot filtration, stirring and transfer Into a 2 L three-necked flask were added 231.9 g of the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1 L of 1,2-dichloroethane, and the mixture was stirred at 15 C. 237.9 g of thionyl chloride was slowly added. claims.evidence_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm. Abstract. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid. Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm. Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction

evidence_lines.text_en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

claims.claimed_en: Into a 2 L three-necked flask were added 231.9 g of the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1 L of 1,2-dichloroethane, and the mixture was stirred at 15 C. 237.9 g of thionyl chloride was slowly added. Reaction at room temperature for 0.5 h, then the temperature was raised to 75 C and held for 3 h. In-process control found the starting material content to be no more than 0.2%. Under -0.098 mP the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure up to 85 C, removing the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane, 500 ml, and triethylamine, 200 g, were added again, and 92 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 0.5 g of acetone cyanohydrin were charged, then held at 40 C for 6 h. The reaction was checked and found to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give the tembotrione product as a red-brown solid. To the tembotrione product was added 40% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, then 5 g of activated carbon was added and held for 1 h, hot filtration, stirring and transfer

Title of invention: Purification method for a tembotrione product

Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.

Background art
Background art

Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.

The synthesis scheme comprises the following:

Into a three-necked flask were added 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane, held at 15 degrees C and stirred. Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid.
